From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Exec: Sponsor alignment — Q3 inference deployment readiness & procurement path

Evelyn / Tim — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please correct me where I misstate anything.

Key business outcomes discussed
- Reduce 99th percentile inference latency from ~520ms to <250ms for core quotes flow (customer-facing).
- Drive per-token cost down ~25% for peak traffic via batching + KV caching to keep ops costs flat as usage scales.
- Support model version pinning and rollout controls for compliance and reproducibility.

Primary pain & risks you called out
- Data residency for EU customers and audit logs for model inputs/outputs (must be retained for 12 months).
- Procurement timeline — legal needs to review SLAs and indemnities; purchasing prefers a PO route vs. long contract negotiation.
- Concern about vendor lock-in and ability to fall back to a quantized on-prem model if needed for specific customers.

Immediate asks from Quantifin
1) SOC2 + evidence summary and data retention options (what we can guarantee in Private deployment).
2) One-pager for the exec procurement committee summarizing outcomes, risks, and procurement path.
3) A proposed pilot scope (30-day) with success criteria and a contact for procurement/legal to review.

Our proposed timeline
- Week of 2026-06-14: share one-pager + SOC2 summary + pilot SOW draft.
- Week of 2026-06-21: begin 30-day pilot in a dedicated environment (customer-managed VPC or Redwood Dedicated depending on your preference).
- Target procurement approval: by 2026-07-01 to allow production rollout in July.

Next steps (action owners)
- Sergio: draft one-pager and pilot SOW, include high-level pricing anchor (deliver by 2026-06-14).
- Marissa: gather SOC2 evidence bundle and produce a short summary doc for procurement.
- Vanessa: assign Solutions Engineer and propose pilot runbook; schedule technical kickoff.
- Tim / Evelyn: share procurement contact and any specific vendor terms to highlight.

Attachments: redwood_q3_pilot_one-pager.pdf (stub), SOC2_summary_for_quantifin.xlsx (stub), procurement_requirements_v1.pdf (stub).

Thanks — Ill follow up with the materials and a calendar invite for the technical kickoff.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Exec: Sponsor alignment — Q3 inference deployment readiness & procurement path

Sergio — appreciate the clear notes. Confirming a few points from our side:

- Priorities: latency and predictable cost are highest — pilot success will be measured by 99p latency reduction and demonstrable cost per 10k requests metric.
- Procurement: looped in ProcureOps (procure.ops@quantifin.com) and our internal legal (tim.reed@quantifin.com) to the thread. They will want the SOC2 summary and sample SLA language.
- Timeline: procurement is targeting decision by the start of July. If we can have pilot materials + legal-friendly SLA language by 6/14 that helps.

Two asks from me now:
1) Please include an explicit fallback/exit clause for pilot participants and an explicit data deletion/retention option in the one-pager.
2) Can you also confirm whether Redwood Private (VPC) supports HSM/KMS integration for key management — we need that spelled out for legal.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call with procurement/legal next week if that helps move things faster.

Thanks,
Evelyn Brooks
VP, Product — Quantifin
evelyn.brooks@quantifin.com | (212) 555-0106
